subject: Fix compatibility for OpenSSL < 3.0 and Almalinux version mismatch for daily tests (#3303)
reason: The change is a compile-time compatibility fix plus CI config. The daily.yml edits only correct container names in the CI matrix. In src/tls.c, the preprocessor guards select SSL_get_peer_certificate()+X509_free() only when OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER < 0x30000000L; against OpenSSL 3.0+ (what the fuzzer's builds link to) the compiled code is identical to the parent, so no runtime difference is reachable. Against OpenSSL < 3.0 the parent commit does not compile at all (SSL_get0_peer_certificate was added in 3.0), so no parent-vs-change comparison or fault run can exercise the new branch. No scenario
